description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 15.05.2023 to 21.05.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) to determine and publish new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. It represents a regulatory matter involving the implementation of customs laws and financial regulations, falling squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
